title: Rich Buckler
description: Armed for adventure is devil-may-care space hero Lando Calrissian, former administrator of the Cloud City of Bespin. "For me, STAR WARS wasn't exactly FLASH GORDON, but it was the next best thing," comments Rich Buckler. "Now, it means even more to me than FLASH." In the comics business for over twenty years, Buckler has drawn nearly every major character in the Marvel and DC universes. He is the creator of Deathlok, the first cyborg in comics. Along with his son Rick and DEATHLOK artist Walter McDaniel, Buckler has formed Visage Studios, which has become a training ground for "up and coming" comic book artists in the New York area.
